post.description: Runs the full pipeline: issuer verification, authenticity, completeness, consistency, compliance.
The officer confirms by hand (phone, letter, site visit) a check the automatic source could not answer.
Inline validation for the officer editor: nothing is stored.
What would change if this pack were active? Nothing is written except an audit entry.
FEATURE_LLM: a local LLM drafts YAML from pasted Handbook text. Returned for review only; it stays a draft until an officer saves and activates it.
The inspection committee's on-site verdict on a flagged item: CONFIRMED (the issue is real) or CLEARED (a false alarm).
Accept or dismiss a flag with a mandatory reason. There is deliberately no 'reject application' action anywhere.
